name: Integrations

initiation_authorization.evidence: Human authorized Phase 07 planning on 2026-08-14 America/Sao_Paulo.

plan_approval.evidence: Human explicitly approved the corrected Phase 07 technical plan for implementation using only the provider-neutral reference adapter and offline fakes. Real providers, sandbox, public callbacks, credentials, deploy, PR and merge remain unauthorized.

expected_models.name: IntegrationConnection
expected_models.purpose: Organization-scoped external connection with provider-neutral lifecycle and opaque secret aliases.

expected_models.name: IntegrationEndpoint
expected_models.purpose: Versioned Organization-scoped ingress or egress endpoint.

expected_models.name: IntegrationDelivery
expected_models.purpose: Canonical outbound delivery bound to an approved source and contract.

expected_models.name: IntegrationDeliveryAttempt
expected_models.purpose: Serialized delivery attempt with lease, bounded retry and uncertain handling.

expected_models.name: IntegrationWebhookReceipt
expected_models.purpose: Authenticated, deduplicated and minimized inbound evidence.

expected_features: Provider-neutral Organization-scoped connections and versioned endpoints.
Reliable egress through the existing integrations queue with leases, bounded retry, backoff and explicit uncertain state.
Authenticated ingress contract with replay protection, deduplication, minimized payload and exact contract version.
Reconciliation and per-connection degraded state without blind retry.
Provider-neutral reference adapter and offline fakes; no concrete commercial connector is required for Phase 07 acceptance.
deferred_features: real providers, credentials, sandbox calls, public webhook registration and production activation
concrete commercial connectors until separately approved
generic arbitrary HTTP callbacks or user code execution
ERP, fiscal, accounting, tax, inventory and marketing connectors

states.rule: Provider states are translated and never directly control canonical domain state; uncertain requires reconciliation or authorized resolution.

snapshots: Persist only Organization, connection/endpoint, source identity/version, contract version, semantic operation and allowlisted scalar routing evidence.
Webhook receipts persist external event id, digest, timestamps, contract version and disposition, never raw body/full headers.
Credentials, tokens, signatures, certificates and raw provider payloads are never canonical integration evidence.
idempotency: Mutable integration commands are Organization-scoped and hash canonical minimized payloads.
Outbound intent is unique per source, endpoint, operation and contract version.
At most one requested/sending/accepted/uncertain attempt exists per delivery.
Ambiguous external acceptance becomes uncertain and is never blindly retried.
Inbound event ids deduplicate within authenticated connection/endpoint scope.
Reconciliation is idempotent by Organization, connection, subject and cursor.
money_rules: Integrations never computes or changes canonical money.
Financial values may only be transported from approved domain snapshots.
External fees never alter Order or Payment totals in Phase 07.
authorization: Human Organization derives from active Membership.
OWNER, ADMIN and MANAGER may configure/reconcile connections and endpoints; OPERATOR receives sanitized operational visibility only.
Inbound Organization derives from authenticated connection/endpoint, never payload tenant fields.
Workers revalidate Organization, connection/endpoint and contract before effects.

required: delivery idempotency, leases, retry, timeout and ambiguous acceptance
webhook authentication, replay, duplicate, wrong-version and cross-Organization rejection
provider-neutral reference adapter success/transient/permanent/ambiguous scenarios with outbound network blocked

coverage.domain_expectation: Critical isolation, idempotency, ambiguity, replay, privacy, concurrency and reconciliation paths require direct tests.

acceptance_criteria: The corrected provider-neutral plan is explicitly approved before implementation.
Implementation remains based on actual_base_sha 09d73050f1df9d52b13e61ae87a26db4b26f365c and approved Phase 06 head e2140eb25cc10f1a79dad05a0507ba9141003ac9.
No concrete commercial connector is required; the offline reference adapter validates ingress, egress, failures, uncertainty and reconciliation.
External systems never directly dictate Orders, Fulfillment, Payments or Messaging state.
Raw payloads and secrets are excluded from persistence/evidence.
No external network call occurs in ordinary CI or request transactions.
Candidate CI, independent Review and QA/Security GO are required before final approval.
Separate human approval remains required for concrete provider selection, sandbox, PR, merge, release, deploy and next phase.
checks: offline reference-adapter fixtures with network blocked

handoff_format.base_sha_semantics: Exact origin/main SHA resolved before branch creation.

allowed_scope: Greenfield provider-neutral Integrations domain after approved plan.
Organization-scoped connections/endpoints, reliable egress, authenticated ingress, idempotency, bounded retry, uncertainty, degraded state and reconciliation.
Minimal public-domain adapters without reverse dependency.
Provider-neutral reference adapter and offline fakes, models, services, selectors, policies, workers, tests, migrations, documentation, audit and sanitized outbox integration.
forbidden_scope: Concrete connectors without separate explicit approval.
Any real provider, sandbox, public webhook, credential, production, deploy or Coolify effect.
Arbitrary HTTP callbacks or remote/user code execution.
Direct provider mutation of canonical domain states.
Persisting raw provider payloads, full headers, credentials, tokens, signatures, cookies, certificates or arbitrary metadata.
Any Flowlog runtime/data/code/infrastructure reuse or linkage.
